study type: Pharmacodynamic study with in vitro component
exposure: Tranexamic acid (TXA) intravenous administration (5, 10, or 15 mg/kg)
TXA added to plasma in vitro
cohort: The study included 30 pregnant women who received intravenous tranexamic acid during cesarean delivery.
finding: The plasmin generation assay effectively detects pharmacologically relevant concentrations of tranexamic acid and demonstrates its inhibition of plasmin generation in women undergoing cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Tranexamic acid-mediated inhibition of plasmin generation was demonstrated in women undergoing cesarean delivery, with the PG assay showing less variability and stronger correlation with TXA concentration compared to ROTEM in this population.
